bead.title: Wire hybrid async recovery and lineage validation
bead.description: Implement recovery for objectlog/hybrid-async. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs, crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs, crates/pqueue-objectlog tests. Recovery must validate SQLite lineage against object-log namespace/manifest generation/segment chain/high-water identity, hydrate memory from the validated SQLite image, replay retained object-log tail greater than sqlite_high_water, rebuild request_id outcomes before serving, and fail closed on mismatch. Out of scope: Helm/runtime env surface.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_async_recovery -- --nocapture` passes.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog hybrid_request_id -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-conformance objectlog_hybrid -- --nocapture` passes.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
